Hullám (03 §2.3)

Abbreviations (US terms)
ch – chain
dc – double crochet
hdc – half double crochet
sc – single crochet
st(s) – stitch(es)
tr – treble

Stitch key (US terms)
chain (ch)
single crochet (sc)
half double crochet (hdc)
double crochet (dc)
treble (tr)

Hullám
Row 1 – foundation: ch 19.
Row 2: skip 1 ch, 2 sc, [hdc, dc, 2 tr, dc, hdc, 2 sc] 2 times (18 sts). Turn.
Row 3: ch 1 (does not count as a st), 18 sc (18 sts). Turn.
Row 4: ch 4 (counts as 1 tr), tr, [dc, hdc, 2 sc, hdc, dc, 2 tr] 2 times (18 sts). Fasten off.
